review.why: Tailors a resume to one job posting by reordering and rewording true experience, with before and after examples.
review.summary: Guides tailoring a resume to a specific job: analyze the posting, audit each section, rewrite the summary, reorder skills and experience, and add keywords naturally. States a truthfulness principle and gives section-by-section examples.
strengths: Before and after examples per section
cautions: Assumes a job-description-analyzer skill is run first
